肯.meaning: Two astronauts argue on the <part>moon</part> about which way is home, back and forth for hours, until one plants a <part>stop</part> sign in the dust between them. They stare at it, burst out laughing, shake gloved hands and at last reach <kanji>agreement</kanji>.
肯.on: They seal the deal by sharing one ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne, frozen solid.
肯.kun: <sound>Ga</sound>rlic fumes from their lunch clog the <sound>en</sound>gine, and the moon <sound>jee</sound>p sputters all the way home.

芯.meaning: A camper's candle has lost its string, so she twists a blade of <part>grass</part> and pokes it right through the <part>heart</part> of the wax. It burns with a green flame and smells like a summer lawn. Her best camping trick yet: a grass <kanji>wick</kanji>.
芯.on: She leans in to sniff it, and hot wax drips onto her <sound>shin</sound>.

践.meaning: A palace <part>spear rack</part> stands by the gate. At midnight a sleepwalking giant comes by, and one huge <part>foot</part> comes down on it with a crunch, flattening every spear. He snores on, never noticing where he chose to <kanji>tread</kanji>.
践.on: The <sound>sen</sound>try on guard just salutes the giant's passing toe.
践.kun: Then he wraps the bent spears in his <sound>fu</sound>ton and goes back to bed.

癒.meaning: A tiny <part>spaceship</part> crash-lands in a farmer's <part>leaky shed</part>, its alien pilot sobbing with a broken <part>heart</part>. The farmer brings tea, the rain drips a lullaby on the roof, and by morning the alien is humming and the ship's dents have popped out. The old shed is good at <kanji>healing</kanji>.
癒.on: The farmer squeezes a <sound>yu</sound>zu into the alien's tea.
癒.kun: Her pet <sound>ee</sound>l wraps round the ship's hull like a bandage.

猿.meaning: A <part>ball gown</part> sweeps across the palace dance floor with nobody's head poking out of the top. From the balcony, a guard lowers a <part>fishhook</part> on a line, snags the hem and lifts. Out tumbles a giggling, long-tailed gatecrasher: a <kanji>monkey</kanji>.
猿.on: It escapes by leaping onto a fire <sound>en</sound>gine parked outside.
猿.kun: As it goes, it drops a silk <sound>sa</sound>ri and a <sound>ru</sound>by ring it pinched from the ball.

措.meaning: A sailor hauls up her <part>anchor</part> and finds a chest from <part>antiquity</part> hooked on it, crusted with barnacles. She's dying to open it, but a storm is rolling in. With a sigh she shoves it under her bunk to <kanji>set aside</kanji> for later.
措.on: When the storm passes, she opens it sitting on her squashy <sound>so</sound>fa.
措.kun: Inside, an <sound>o</sound>ctopus is curled round a heap of old coins.

霜.meaning: A night of light <part>rain</part> falls on two neighbours' cars parked nose to nose. By dawn both windscreens are white and feathery, and the neighbours scrape away in <part>mutual</part> misery, each blaming the other's car for the cold. It's only <kanji>frost</kanji>.
霜.on: One tries rubbing it off with a warm, sudsy bar of <sound>so</sound>ap.
霜.kun: <sound>She</sound> gives up, grabs a <sound>mo</sound>p and scrubs till the glass squeaks.
